essence: The text undertakes to expound her traditional worship.
There is a nyāsa beginning with the month and including the sage and others.
After worshipping Kavyavaha, one should place a washed vessel upon that.
The flame-mouthed one is asked to destroy all obstacles.
The verse identifies these as the streams of siddhas.
